Scientific question

How can a two-dimensional dynamo model help investigate magnetic-field evolution and tachocline confinement?

Why it matters

Numerical experiments make it possible to explore the interaction of flows and magnetic fields over time.

My contribution

Developing a simulation project with an object-oriented C++ implementation, Python bindings, and an interactive visualization interface.
